data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 明确以可复用的 Agent Harness 代码为改进对象，验证轨迹驱动局部修改，候选进入角色池供后续重组，并有迭代提升证据。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Validation traces then guide local code edits
scope_support.object_quote: organizes each harness into functional modules with explicit role-specific interfaces, allowing alternative implementations of each module to be substituted and recombined
scope_support.persistence_quote: the resulting candidates are incorporated into fixed-capacity role-specific pools for subsequent recombination
